title: Among Us (Sus)
blurb: Some games leave behind a mechanic; Among Us left behind a word. Sus went from crewmate shorthand to genuine everyday vocabulary in the space of about six months, and this audio is the concept in sound form — suspicion with nothing concrete behind it, which is precisely how the game works. Play it when a story does not quite add up, when somebody appears from a corridor they had no reason to be in, or when a friend behaves even slightly unusually near a task they have never previously volunteered for.
origin: From Among Us, the game that made 'sus' a permanent part of the language.
